```yaml
name: Auto-close stale PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * *" # Daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  close-stale-prs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Close stale PRs
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Fetch open PRs
          prs=$(gh pr list --state open --json number,author,labels,createdAt --jq '.')
          
          # Calculate cutoff date (30 days ago)
          cutoff_date=$(date -u -d "30 days ago" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          
          echo "Cutoff date: $cutoff_date"
          
          # Process each PR
          echo "$prs" | jq -c '.[]' | while read -r pr; do
            pr_number=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.number')
            author=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.author.login')
            created_at=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.createdAt')
            has_keep_label=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.labels[] | select(.name == "keep-open") | .name')
            
            # Skip if authored by jdx
            if [ "$author" = "jdx" ]; then
              echo "Skipping PR #$pr_number by maintainer jdx"
              continue
            fi
            
            # Skip if labeled with keep-open
            if [ -n "$has_keep_label" ]; then
              echo "Skipping PR #$pr_number with keep-open label"
              continue
            fi
            
            # Check if PR is older than 30 days
            if [[ "$created_at" < "$cutoff_date" ]]; then
              echo "Closing stale PR #$pr_number (created: $created_at)"
              
              # Comment on the PR
              gh pr comment "$pr_number" --body "This PR has been automatically closed due to inactivity (older than 30 days). If you'd like to continue working on this, please reopen it or create a new PR."
              
              # Close the PR
              gh pr close "$pr_number" --comment "Auto-closed due to inactivity"
            else
              echo "PR #$pr_number is not stale (created: $created_at)"
            fi
          done
```
